why: Below the marker the copy matches, so `chunks_compared` moves and `chunks_mismatched` does not. Above it the three uncopied rows are read as tail and reported as missing - which is correct and is **not** a failure of the backfill: they are rows the fan-out would have carried in a real migration. Two pairs of counters because two mechanisms can fail, and a single pair would send an operator to the wrong half of the system. `rows_source` and `rows_target` are reported and not gated on: two counts of live tables are taken at different instants.
